title: Free PDF Merger — Combine PDF Files Online Without Watermarks

content.intro: Combining multiple PDFs shouldn't require expensive software. Craftisle's free PDF Merger lets you drag, drop, reorder, and merge PDFs in your browser — no upload to servers, no watermarks, no file size limits.

sections.heading: Why Local Processing Matters
sections.body: Most online PDF mergers upload your files to a server — a privacy risk for sensitive documents. Our tool uses PDF.js + browser APIs to process everything locally. Your files never leave your computer. This also means it works offline and is faster than server-based alternatives.

sections.heading: How to Merge PDFs
sections.body: 1. Drag and drop your PDF files, or click to browse. 2. Drag to reorder pages within and across files. 3. Optionally select specific pages to include (e.g., pages 1-3, 5, 7-10). 4. Click Merge. 5. Download your combined PDF. Average merge time: under 3 seconds for typical documents.

sections.heading: Supported Features
sections.body: Merge unlimited files (tested up to 50 files, 500+ pages). Preserve original quality and formatting. Maintain bookmarks and internal links. Handle different page sizes (A4, Letter, Legal) within one document. Optional page rotation and deletion before merging.

sections.heading: Common Use Cases
sections.body: Combine monthly reports into a quarterly document. Merge scanned pages into one searchable PDF. Assemble a portfolio from multiple project files. Consolidate invoices for accounting. Create a reading packet from separate articles or chapters.

content.conclusion: PDF merging shouldn't cost money or compromise privacy. Craftisle's Merger is free, fast, and secure — everything stays in your browser. Bookmark it for your next document assembly task.
